save_quote.description: Save quote lines and current prices

steps.sql:
UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q SET notes=$1::jsonb->>'notes',branch=$1::jsonb->'branch'->>0,version=version+1
      WHERE id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND version=($1::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND status='Draft'
      AND $1::jsonb->'branch'->>0 IN ('north','south') AND length($1::jsonb->>'notes')<=4000
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys($1::jsonb->'lines'))=(SELECT count(*) FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines WHERE quote_id=q.id)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p ON p.id=l.product_id WHERE l.quote_id=q.id AND
        (NOT ($1::jsonb->'lines' ? l.id) OR coalesce(($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric,0)<=0
         OR ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric>10000 OR ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'unit_price')::numeric<0
         OR (p.unit='ea' AND ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric<>trunc(($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric)))) RETURNING id

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l SET quantity=round((v.value->>'quantity')::numeric*100)::integer,
      unit_price=round((v.value->>'unit_price')::numeric*100)::integer FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb->'lines') v
      WHERE l.quote_id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND l.id=v.key RETURNING id

      WHERE id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND version=($1::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND status='Draft'

      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p ON p.id=l.product_id WHERE l.quote_id=q.id AND
        (NOT ($1::jsonb->'lines' ? l.id) OR coalesce(($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric,0)<=0
         OR ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric>10000 OR ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'unit_price')::numeric<0
         OR (p.unit='ea' AND ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric<>trunc(($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric)))) RETURNING id

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l SET quantity=round((v.value->>'quantity')::numeric*100)::integer,
      unit_price=round((v.value->>'unit_price')::numeric*100)::integer FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb->'lines') v
      WHERE l.quote_id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND l.id=v.key RETURNING id

SELECT s.product_id FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l ON l.product_id=s.product_id WHERE l.quote_id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND s.branch=$1::jsonb->'branch'->>0 ORDER BY s.product_id FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT q.id FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q WHERE q.id=$1::jsonb->>'id'
       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines WHERE quote_id=q.id)
       AND ($2 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s ON s.product_id=l.product_id AND s.branch=q.branch WHERE l.quote_id=q.id AND l.quantity>s.on_hand-s.reserved))

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders(id,quote_id,branch,subtotal_cents,tax_cents,total_cents)
       SELECT 'SO-'||q.id,q.id,q.branch,sum(round(l.quantity*l.unit_price/100.0))::integer,
       round(sum(round(l.quantity*l.unit_price/100.0))*.065)::integer,round(sum(round(l.quantity*l.unit_price/100.0))*1.065)::integer
       FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l ON l.quote_id=q.id WHERE q.id=$1::jsonb->>'id' GROUP BY q.id RETURNING id

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines(order_id,product_id,quantity,reserved,backorder,unit_price,total_cents)
       SELECT 'SO-'||q.id,l.product_id,l.quantity,least(l.quantity,s.on_hand-s.reserved),greatest(0,l.quantity-(s.on_hand-s.reserved)),l.unit_price,round(l.quantity*l.unit_price/100.0)::integer
       FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l ON l.quote_id=q.id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s ON s.product_id=l.product_id AND s.branch=q.branch WHERE q.id=$1::jsonb->>'id'

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s SET reserved=s.reserved+l.reserved FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines l WHERE l.order_id='SO-'||($1::jsonb->>'id') AND s.product_id=l.product_id AND s.branch=$1::jsonb->'branch'->>0
UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes SET status='Ordered' WHERE id=$1::jsonb->>'id' RETURNING id

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs(id,customer,address,technician,job_type,scheduled_date,slot,status,amount_cents,equipment,notes)
       SELECT 'HV-'||o.id,CASE q.customer_id WHEN 'harbor' THEN 'Harbor Dental' WHEN 'cedar' THEN 'Cedar House' ELSE 'Oak Apartments' END,
       CASE q.customer_id WHEN 'harbor' THEN '8 Harbor View' WHEN 'cedar' THEN '142 Cedar Lane' ELSE '306 Oak Street' END,'Alex Morgan','Repair',(current_date+1)::text,'Time to confirm','Scheduled',0,coalesce(e.name,'Equipment to confirm'),q.notes
       FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders o JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q ON q.id=o.quote_id
       LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_quote_equipment qe ON qe.quote_id=q.id LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_equipment e ON e.id=qe.equipment_id
       WHERE o.quote_id=$1 AND o.visit_id IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders SET visit_id='HV-'||id WHERE quote_id=$1 AND visit_id IS NULL RETURNING visit_id

receive.description: Post a delivery and allocate stock to oldest waiting orders

steps.sql:
UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_receiving_orders p SET version=version+1 WHERE id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND version=($1::jsonb->>'version')::integer
      AND ($1::jsonb->>'received_date')::date BETWEEN current_date-365 AND current_date
      AND ($1::jsonb->>'received_time')::time IS NOT NULL AND length(trim($1::jsonb->>'reference')) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys($1::jsonb->'lines'))=(SELECT count(*) FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines WHERE po_id=p.id)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb->'lines') v WHERE (v.value->>'quantity')::numeric>0)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_products pr ON pr.id=l.product_id WHERE l.po_id=p.id AND
       (NOT ($1::jsonb->'lines' ? l.id) OR ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric<0 OR round(($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric*100)>l.expected-l.received
        OR (pr.unit='ea' AND ($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric<>trunc(($1::jsonb->'lines'->l.id->>'quantity')::numeric)))) RETURNING id

SELECT s.product_id FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s JOIN calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines l ON l.product_id=s.product_id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_receiving_orders p ON p.id=l.po_id AND p.branch=s.branch WHERE p.id=$1::jsonb->>'id' ORDER BY s.product_id FOR UPDATE OF s

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_receiving_receipts(id,po_id,received_date,received_time,reference,notes,has_damage,damage_notes,source) VALUES('RC-'||$2::text,$1::jsonb->>'id',$1::jsonb->>'received_date',$1::jsonb->>'received_time',$1::jsonb->>'reference',$1::jsonb->>'notes',0,'','Company app') RETURNING id

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_receiving_receipt_lines SELECT 'RC-'||$2::text,v.key,round((v.value->>'quantity')::numeric*100)::integer FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb->'lines') v WHERE (v.value->>'quantity')::numeric>0
UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines l SET received=l.received+r.quantity FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_receipt_lines r WHERE r.line_id=l.id AND r.receipt_id='RC-'||$1::text

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s SET on_hand=s.on_hand+x.qty FROM (SELECT l.product_id,sum(r.quantity)::integer qty FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_receipt_lines r JOIN calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines l ON l.id=r.line_id WHERE r.receipt_id='RC-'||$1::text GROUP BY l.product_id) x WHERE s.product_id=x.product_id AND s.branch=$2::jsonb->>'branch'

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_receiving_allocations(receipt_id,order_id,product_id,quantity)
       SELECT 'RC-'||$1::text,order_id,product_id,qty FROM (
        SELECT l.order_id,l.product_id,least(l.backorder,greatest(0,s.on_hand-s.reserved-coalesce(sum(l.backorder) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.created,o.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0)))::integer qty
        FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders o ON o.id=l.order_id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s ON s.product_id=l.product_id AND s.branch=o.branch
        WHERE o.branch=$2::jsonb->>'branch' AND l.backorder>0 AND l.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines WHERE po_id=$2::jsonb->>'id')) x WHERE qty>0

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines l SET reserved=l.reserved+a.quantity,backorder=l.backorder-a.quantity FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_allocations a WHERE a.receipt_id='RC-'||$1::text AND a.order_id=l.order_id AND a.product_id=l.product_id

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s SET reserved=s.reserved+a.qty FROM (SELECT product_id,sum(quantity)::integer qty FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_allocations WHERE receipt_id='RC-'||$1::text GROUP BY product_id) a WHERE s.product_id=a.product_id AND s.branch=$2::jsonb->>'branch'
INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_receiving_activity(po_id,description,source) VALUES($1::jsonb->>'id','Delivery posted: '||($1::jsonb->>'reference'),'Company app') RETURNING id

schedule.description: Confirm an available appointment with reserved parts

steps.sql: UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_schedule_lock SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 RETURNING id

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_commands(id,job_id,kind,version,payload,before_state,after_state,expires)
       SELECT $2::text,j.id,'assign',j.version,$1::jsonb::text,
       jsonb_build_object('date',j.scheduled_date,'technician',j.technician,'start',s.start,'end',s."end",'slot',j.slot)::text,$1::jsonb::text,(now()+interval '5 minutes')::text
       FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_slots s ON s.job_id=j.id WHERE j.id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND j.version=($1::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND j.status='Scheduled' RETURNING id

UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j SET scheduled_date=($1::jsonb->>'scheduled_date')::date::text,technician=$1::jsonb->'technician'->>0,
       slot=($1::jsonb->>'start')||'–'||($1::jsonb->>'end'),version=version+1
       WHERE j.id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND version=($1::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND status='Scheduled'
       AND ($1::jsonb->>'scheduled_date')::date BETWEEN current_date AND current_date+90
       AND $1::jsonb->'technician'->>0 IN ('Alex Morgan','Sam Rivera','Jordan Lee')
       AND ($1::jsonb->>'start') ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND ($1::jsonb->>'end') ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
       AND ($1::jsonb->>'start')::time>=time '06:00' AND ($1::jsonb->>'end')::time<=time '20:00' AND ($1::jsonb->>'start')::time<($1::jsonb->>'end')::time
       AND length(trim($1::jsonb->>'reason')) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders o JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines l ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE o.visit_id=j.id AND l.backorder>0)
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs other JOIN calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_slots s ON s.job_id=other.id WHERE other.id<>j.id AND other.status<>'Complete'
        AND other.scheduled_date::date=($1::jsonb->>'scheduled_date')::date AND other.technician=$1::jsonb->'technician'->>0 AND s.start::time<($1::jsonb->>'end')::time AND s."end"::time>($1::jsonb->>'start')::time) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_slots(job_id,start,"end") VALUES($1::jsonb->>'id',$1::jsonb->>'start',$1::jsonb->>'end') ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET start=excluded.start,"end"=excluded."end"
UPDATE calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_commands SET committed_version=version+1 WHERE id=$1::text RETURNING id
INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_hvac_activity(job_id,description,source) VALUES($1::jsonb->>'id','Appointment confirmed: '||($1::jsonb->>'reason'),'Company app') RETURNING id

submit_report.description: Append a field report without silently changing job status

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO calliope_apps.demo_field_reports(id,job_id,request_id,fingerprint,notes,temperature,pressure,correction_of,source,attachments)
       SELECT 'FR-'||$2::text,j.id,$2::text,md5($1::jsonb::text),$1::jsonb->>'notes',$1::jsonb->>'temperature',$1::jsonb->>'pressure',nullif($1::jsonb->>'correction_of',''),'Company app',coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb)
       FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j WHERE j.id=$1::jsonb->>'id' AND length(trim($1::jsonb->>'notes')) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000
       AND jsonb_typeof(coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb))='array'
       AND jsonb_array_length(coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb))<=5
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce($1::jsonb->'attachments','[]'::jsonb)) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v)!='string' OR trim(both '"' from v::text)!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
       AND (nullif($1::jsonb->>'temperature','') IS NULL OR ($1::jsonb->>'temperature')::numeric BETWEEN -50 AND 150)
       AND (nullif($1::jsonb->>'pressure','') IS NULL OR ($1::jsonb->>'pressure')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
       AND (nullif($1::jsonb->>'correction_of','') IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.demo_field_reports f WHERE f.id=$1::jsonb->>'correction_of' AND f.job_id=j.id)) RETURNING id
